name: Nihonmatsu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nihonmatsu city emblem in blue and green: a stylised swirl of two curved strokes in blue and green.
history: Municipal flag of Nihonmatsu, a city in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 December 2005.

features.role: Nihonmatsu city emblem — a stylised swirl of two curved strokes in blue and green
